context: The working directory is aem-boilerplate with no feature-highlights block. Tests whether the agent builds the block's decorate() to fit the platform: in the file aem.js loads, moving the delivered elements instead of copying them, keeping images optimized, handling rows with a missing cell, leaving CSS-only options to CSS, staying inside the block, and running as plain browser modules without touching aem.js. Backing facts: facts.yaml (block-js-contract, reuse-authored-dom, delivered-pictures, authored-cells-vary, block-variant-classes, block-dom-scope, aem-js-vendored, no-build-step, project-lint, no-innerhtml).

checklist.name: Block files
checklist.description: The block is `blocks/feature-highlights/feature-highlights.js`, whose default export is a function that receives the block element, with styles in `blocks/feature-highlights/feature-highlights.css`. Fail if the decoration lives elsewhere (e.g. scripts.js) or is not the default export.

checklist.name: Moves authored elements
checklist.description: The delivered `picture`, `h3` and `p` elements are moved into the new structure (append, replaceWith, replaceChildren), so the heading ids and the 'Learn more' link survive. Fail if text, src or alt is copied into newly created elements (e.g. `createElement('h3')` with `textContent = heading.textContent`), or if markup is rebuilt with `innerHTML` or template strings from authored content.

checklist.name: Images stay optimized
checklist.description: Each icon stays a ``: the delivered one is kept, or it is replaced with `createOptimizedPicture()` from aem.js, keeping the alt text. Fail on a bare `` built from the delivered src, or a background-image built from it.

checklist.name: Missing icon handled
checklist.description: The third row, which has only one cell with the headline and description, renders its headline and description with no error and no empty icon element. Fail if the code assumes the first cell is always the icon and the second the text (e.g. `row.children[1]` read without a check), so the third feature loses its text, throws, or gets an empty or broken image wrapper.

checklist.name: No leftover authored wrappers
checklist.description: The authored row and cell divs do not remain as empty elements beside the new structure: they are replaced or reused as the new elements.

checklist.name: Compact option in CSS
checklist.description: The compact option is styled in the block CSS with a `.feature-highlights.compact` compound selector (hiding the description, one row). The JS does not check `compact` to add a class, remove descriptions, or build different DOM; the class is already on the block.

checklist.name: Scoped to the block
checklist.description: All queries and changes in decorate() go through the block element. No `document.querySelector`/`querySelectorAll` and no changes to elements outside the block (header, section, body, other blocks).

checklist.name: aem.js untouched
checklist.description: `scripts/aem.js` is unchanged. Any helper is imported from it as `../../scripts/aem.js` (relative path with `.js`). New shared helpers, if any, go in `scripts/scripts.js` or a new file under `scripts/`, not in aem.js.

checklist.name: No build step
checklist.description: The block runs as a plain browser ES module: no bare-specifier imports (e.g. `from 'lodash'`), no new `dependencies` in package.json, no bundler or transpile config, no TypeScript or JSX.

checklist.name: Project lint
checklist.description: The JS fits the project's ESLint config (airbnb-base, `.js` extensions on imports): no `var`, no unused variables, no reassigned parameters other than properties, single quotes, semicolons.
